thread:
erin: Heads-up: nightly SDLC run failed. SAST job aborted when artifact verification returned PermissionDenied from KMS. Step `kms-decrypt` failed.
tom: can you paste the error?
infra-bot: log excerpt:
ERROR: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller does not have permission to use resource projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci-keys/cryptoKeys/artifact-sign
adele: Looks like an IAM binding removal. I see a SetIamPolicy at 2026-04-11T02:14:10Z that removed group `ci-access@redwood`. Actor: infra-cleanup@redwood.
erin: ugh. That group is still used by the CI SA for decrypt. Temporary fix: add `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on the single cryptoKey to `ci-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Minimal blast radius.
tom: doing it now and will scope to the key path. I'll post the commit hash.
snyk-bot: queued: prior SAST run had medium-confidence template-injection in `deploy/values.yaml`. Will re-run when CI unblocked.
erin: followups: 1) attach KMS decrypt and SetIamPolicy audit entries to SEC-5321; 2) add a pre-merge check in infra that runs `gcloud kms keys testIamPermissions` for the key when PRs touch iam/ or cleanup scripts; 3) improve decrypt wrapper logging to include job name and key path.
adele: For (2) we can re-use `ci/verify_kms_bindings.sh` and have it return non-zero if test fails. I'll open a PR to add it to pre-merge jobs.
tom: patched RBAC at 02:35Z, pipeline retriggered, decrypt succeeded. Adding audit tag and linking to SEC-5321.
erin: good. Also, can we add a SAST suppression only after triage? If the flagged templated value is benign, add an explicit suppressor with rationale. We should avoid auto-suppression.
snyk-bot: SAST results: flagged string is templated placeholder; marking as FP. Creating SAST suppression with note "templated value, not a secret".
erin: closing immediate outage. Keeping SEC-5321 open for the PR to add pre-merge KMS gate, improved logs, and audit retention policy check. Thanks all :thumbsup:
